rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: In the press-conference record 麻生内閣総理大臣記者会見 dated 16 September 2009, Aso says the cabinet resigned en masse at the cabinet meeting earlier that day (先ほどの閣議で、この内閣は総辞職をいたしました) and that he is leaving office midway (道半ばで退任することになりました).

locator.section: date line 平成２１年９月１６日; 【麻生総理冒頭発言】 first and third paragraphs

rows.text: In the same opening remarks (【麻生総理冒頭発言】) he recalls that the cabinet was launched on 24 September the previous year (昨年の９月24日の発足以来).
